'''2008 US West Nationals''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG national championship held over the weekend of 1–3 August 2008 at the Super 8 on the Las Vegas Strip, Las Vegas, Nevada; the forum board for the event was titled "[West Nationals] Super 8, Las Vegas Strip, August 1st thru 3rd, 2008".<ref name="pcf-22209-320975">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=320975#320975 West Nats Round-by-round results], arebelspy, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (3 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080820012716/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=321604&sid=05f16466b8f4d8c44b1a47aef206b3a7 Internet Archive]</ref> Chris, of Team SoCal, ran the weekend, and Team SoCal's Kevin and Aaron took first and second place.<ref name="pcf-22209-320975" /> The top four were Kyle, Mike, Aaron and Kevin.<ref name="pcf-22209-320975" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Super 8, Las Vegas Strip, Las Vegas, Nevada<ref name="pcf-22209-320975" />
* '''Dates:''' 1–3 August 2008<ref name="pcf-22209-320975" />
* '''Organizer:''' Chris (Team SoCal; surname not posted)<ref name="pcf-22209-320975" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]<ref name="pcf-22209-320975" />

== Planning ==

In late May 2008 no date had been set for the event. [[Scott Church]] (CategoryOneGames.com) had suggested 23 August, saying the Players Committee was "dragging their feet". [[Chris Schoenthal]] (imrahil327) asked to look at the weekend of 2 August instead, because he would be back in school by 23 August. He also proposed a mini-open / West Nationals / Nevada State Championship weekend like Minnesota's mini-open / State Championship / Bespin Regionals weekend, with the Nevada event played as [[Cube]] if enough players could be found. Replying, arebelspy agreed to 2 August and proposed a constructed mini-open on Friday, constructed West Nationals on Saturday cut to a top four, and the top four played on Sunday while the Nevada State Championship ran as a Cube event.<ref name="sf-21008-304090">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=304090#p304090 Road to Worlds - Western US - All West States Events/Plans], arebelspy, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (28 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125190718/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21008.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Church's "Road to Worlds" calendar for the western United States then listed the Nevada State Championship on 1 August, the Western Nationals on 2 August and a Nevada Mini-Open on 3 August. It gave the Western Nationals venue as the Super 8 Motel, 4250 Koval Lane, Las Vegas.<ref name="sf-21008-303347">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=303347#p303347 Road to Worlds - Western US - All West States Events/Plans], CategoryOneGames.com (Scott Church), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (23 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125190718/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21008.html Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee's list of 2008 World Championship Day 2 automatic bids gives the two West Nationals bids to [[Kyle Krueger]] (listed as "Kyle Kreuger") and [[Chris Fanchi]].<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref>

A player of the SoCal group posting as imrahil327 thanked Team Ohio for flying out and the Las Vegas locals for playing,<ref name="pcf-22209-320981">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=320981#320981 West Nats Round-by-round results], imrahil327, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (3 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080820012716/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=321604&sid=05f16466b8f4d8c44b1a47aef206b3a7 Internet Archive]</ref> and wrote that no Sunday consolation qualifier was held, for lack of interest.<ref name="pcf-22209-321207">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=321207#321207 West Nats Round-by-round results], imrahil327, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 August 2008).
